blocks.text:
In the morning, enjoy a sightseeing tour of Belize City.

Belize City was founded in the second quarter of the 17th century by British pirates on the site of a small Maya settlement called Olsuz. Thanks to its location on the Caribbean Sea, close to the mouths of several rivers, the city grew rapidly.

After repeated natural disasters, the country's capital was moved to Belmopan. Belize City nevertheless remained the largest city in Belize and an important seaport.

Highlights include the Performing Arts Centre, the Eco-Museum, the former British governor's residence and St John's Anglican Cathedral, built in 1812.

After the tour, transfer to Belize International Airport for your flight home.
